title: Nationwide Fibre Optic Backbone for Government Network

demo_extraction.scope_summary: Lay 3,000 km of fibre optic backbone connecting federal and provincial offices. Supply and commission DWDM and core routing equipment. Operate and maintain the network for five years.

eligibility.requirement: Valid NTN and active ATL status
eligibility.source_quote: The bidder must hold a valid National Tax Number (NTN) and appear on the FBR Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

eligibility.requirement: Minimum average annual turnover of PKR 500 million over the last three years.
